clips.send: Now cut two parallel lines with a third line, a transversal. The bottom crossing makes the familiar pattern of four angles. Slide that whole crossing up the transversal: because the lines are parallel, it lands exactly on the top crossing.
clips.text: Now cut two parallel lines with a third line, a transversal. The bottom crossing makes the familiar pattern of four angles. Slide that whole crossing up the transversal: because the lines are parallel, it lands exactly on the top crossing.

clips.send: An angle measures how far something turns. Spin the yellow ray: a quarter turn is 90 degrees (a right angle), a half turn is 180 degrees (a straight angle), and a full turn is 360 degrees .
clips.text: An angle measures how far something turns. Spin the yellow ray: a quarter turn is 90 circ (a right angle), a half turn is 180 circ (a straight angle), and a full turn is 360 circ.

clips.send: One angle is enough! Here one angle is 115 degrees . Its vertical angle is also 115 degrees , its neighbours on the line are 180 degrees minus 115 degrees equals 65 degrees , and the bottom crossing copies the top. All eight angles from one.
clips.text: One angle is enough! Here one angle is 115 circ. Its vertical angle is also 115 circ, its neighbours on the line are 180 circ - 115 circ = 65 circ, and the bottom crossing copies the top. All eight angles from one.

clips.send: Split a straight angle with a ray. However the ray turns, the two angles always fill the half turn, so they add to 180 degrees . Two angles that add to 180 degrees are called supplementary.
clips.text: Split a straight angle with a ray. However the ray turns, the two angles always fill the half turn, so they add to 180 circ. Two angles that add to 180 circ are called supplementary.

clips.send: Do the same inside a right angle. Now the two parts always add to 90 degrees . Two angles that add to 90 degrees are called complementary.
clips.text: Do the same inside a right angle. Now the two parts always add to 90 circ. Two angles that add to 90 circ are called complementary.

clips.send: Use it: a triangle has angles of 47 degrees and 68 degrees . The third angle is x equals 180 degrees minus 47 degrees minus 68 degrees equals 65 degrees .
clips.text: Use it: a triangle has angles of 47 circ and 68 circ. The third angle is x = 180 circ - 47 circ - 68 circ = 65 circ.

clips.send: So all eight angles come in just two sizes. Matching corners are corresponding angles; the Z-shaped pair are alternate interior angles; both pairs are equal. Same-side interior angles add to 180 degrees . Tilt the transversal: it all stays true.
clips.text: So all eight angles come in just two sizes. Matching corners are corresponding angles; the Z-shaped pair are alternate interior angles; both pairs are equal. Same-side interior angles add to 180 circ. Tilt the transversal: it all stays true.

clips.send: Now a triangle. Its angles measure about 63 degrees , 51 degrees and 66 degrees . Tear off the three corners and put them side by side: together they make a straight line, 180 degrees .
clips.text: Now a triangle. Its angles measure about 63 circ, 51 circ and 66 circ. Tear off the three corners and put them side by side: together they make a straight line, 180 circ.

clips.send: Why always? Draw a line through the top corner, parallel to the bottom side. The Z shapes are alternate interior angles, so copies of the two bottom angles fit along that line beside the top angle. A straight line is 180 degrees , so a plus b plus c equals 180 degrees in every triangle.
clips.text: Why always? Draw a line through the top corner, parallel to the bottom side. The Z shapes are alternate interior angles, so copies of the two bottom angles fit along that line beside the top angle. A straight line is 180 circ, so a + b + c = 180 circ in every triangle.

clips.send: Two lines cross and make four angles. Turn one line: the angles change, but opposite angles always match. Why? a plus b equals 180 degrees and b plus c equals 180 degrees , so a equals c . Opposite angles like these are vertical angles, and they are always equal.
clips.text: Two lines cross and make four angles. Turn one line: the angles change, but opposite angles always match. Why? a + b = 180 circ and b + c = 180 circ, so a = c. Opposite angles like these are vertical angles, and they are always equal.

clips.send: 所以八个角只有两种大小。位置相同的角是同位角；呈“Z”字形的一对是内错角；它们都相等。同旁内角的和为 180 度 。转动截线，这些关系依然成立。
clips.text: 所以八个角只有两种大小。位置相同的角是同位角；呈“Z”字形的一对是内错角；它们都相等。同旁内角的和为 180 circ。转动截线，这些关系依然成立。

clips.send: 在直角里做同样的事。现在两部分的和总是 90 度 。和为 90 度 的两个角互为余角。
clips.text: 在直角里做同样的事。现在两部分的和总是 90 circ。和为 90 circ 的两个角互为余角。

clips.send: 用一条射线把平角分成两部分。不管射线怎么转，两个角合起来总是半圈，和为 180 度 。和为 180 度 的两个角互为补角。
clips.text: 用一条射线把平角分成两部分。不管射线怎么转，两个角合起来总是半圈，和为 180 circ。和为 180 circ 的两个角互为补角。

clips.send: 两条直线相交，形成四个角。转动其中一条线：角的大小在变，但相对的两个角始终相等。为什么？ a 加 b 等于 180 度 , b 加 c 等于 180 度 ，所以 a 等于 c 。像这样相对的两个角叫作对顶角，对顶角相等。
clips.text: 两条直线相交，形成四个角。转动其中一条线：角的大小在变，但相对的两个角始终相等。为什么？a + b = 180 circ,b + c = 180 circ，所以 a = c。像这样相对的两个角叫作对顶角，对顶角相等。

clips.send: 为什么总是这样？过顶点画一条与底边平行的直线。两个“Z”形告诉我们这是内错角：底边的两个角可以原样“搬”到顶点两侧，和顶角一起铺满这条直线。平角是 180 度 ，所以任何三角形都有 a 加 b 加 c 等于 180 度 。
clips.text: 为什么总是这样？过顶点画一条与底边平行的直线。两个“Z”形告诉我们这是内错角：底边的两个角可以原样“搬”到顶点两侧，和顶角一起铺满这条直线。平角是 180 circ，所以任何三角形都有 a + b + c = 180 circ。

clips.send: 角表示“转了多少”。转动黄色的射线：转四分之一圈是 90 度 （直角），转半圈是 180 度 （平角），转一整圈是 360 度 （周角）。
clips.text: 角表示“转了多少”。转动黄色的射线：转四分之一圈是 90 circ（直角），转半圈是 180 circ（平角），转一整圈是 360 circ（周角）。

clips.send: 用起来：一个三角形有两个角是 47 度 和 68 度 。第三个角 x 等于 180 度 - 47 度 - 68 度 等于 65 度 。
clips.text: 用起来：一个三角形有两个角是 47 circ 和 68 circ。第三个角 x = 180 circ - 47 circ - 68 circ = 65 circ。

clips.send: 容易混淆：互余（和为 90 度 ）和互补（和为 180 度 ）容易记反：互余的两个角拼成一个直角，互补的两个角拼成一个平角。另外，同位角、内错角相等，只有在两条直线平行时才成立。
clips.text: 容易混淆：互余（和为 90°）和互补（和为 180°）容易记反：互余的两个角拼成一个直角，互补的两个角拼成一个平角。另外，同位角、内错角相等，只有在两条直线平行时才成立。

clips.send: 一个角就够了！这里已知一个角是 115 度 。它的对顶角也是 115 度 ，与它组成平角的相邻角是 180 度 - 115 度 等于 65 度 ，下面的交叉点又是上面的“复制品”。一个角就能求出全部八个角！
clips.text: 一个角就够了！这里已知一个角是 115 circ。它的对顶角也是 115 circ，与它组成平角的相邻角是 180 circ - 115 circ = 65 circ，下面的交叉点又是上面的“复制品”。一个角就能求出全部八个角！

clips.send: 现在看一个三角形。它的三个角大约是 63 度 、 51 度 和 66 度 。把三个角“撕”下来并排拼在一起：它们正好拼成一条直线，也就是 180 度 。
clips.text: 现在看一个三角形。它的三个角大约是 63 circ、51 circ 和 66 circ。把三个角“撕”下来并排拼在一起：它们正好拼成一条直线，也就是 180 circ。

clips.send: 现在用第三条直线（截线）去截两条平行线。下面的交点处形成熟悉的四个角。把整个交叉点沿着截线向上平移：因为两条线平行，它正好与上面的交叉点完全重合。
